component.name: Radiotrope
component.summary: Listen to and record internet radio

description.p: An internet radio player for the desktop. Play it yourself, from your phone, or let your AI assistant drive it over the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

ul.li: Find stations: typo-tolerant search by name, country, genre and language in the Radiotrope station directory, or play any stream address
Plays almost anything: MP3, AAC, HE-AAC, Vorbis, Opus and FLAC over Icecast/SHOUTcast, HLS and plain HTTP, with song titles from ICY and ID3
Sounds right: 10-band equalizer with 14 presets, volume leveler, hiss, hum and rumble filters
Records: MP3, Opus or WAV, by hand or on a schedule
Wakes you, sends you to sleep: Scheduler for plays, recordings and stops, plus a sleep timer
AI agents: 19 MCP tools, shared by every agent on your computer or your network
Phone remote: pair the Radiotrope Remote app with a QR code
Also: a terminal player and a station checker for monitoring

screenshot.caption: Favorites, the playing station and the spectrum visualizer
